items.name: button
items.title: VFX UI Anime Button
items.description: A button that reacts like an anime impact frame: it squashes when pressed, inverts for one frame on release, and a burst goes off behind it with clouds and ドン!. A secondary variant is quieter. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-button>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: VFX UI Anime Button is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /vfx-ui-anime/button.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <vfx-button>Confirm</vfx-button> (variant="secondary" for the quiet one). Listen for click; call el.done() when the action worked to land a check on it. More: https://vfx-ui-anime.vercel.app

items.name: toggle
items.title: VFX UI Anime Toggle
items.description: A switch whose flip is 43 painted frames: the knob smears across, slams into the end, throws up a splash, and the track floods and settles. The frames are inside the file (about 500 KB). One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-toggle>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: VFX UI Anime Toggle is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /vfx-ui-anime/toggle.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <vfx-toggle label="Notifications"></vfx-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://vfx-ui-anime.vercel.app

items.name: slider
items.title: VFX UI Anime Slider
items.description: A range slider whose thumb stretches and lags on a spring, with cumulus rolling up behind a fast drag and a crescent thrown ahead on release. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-slider>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: VFX UI Anime Slider is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /vfx-ui-anime/slider.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <vfx-slider value="30" label="Volume"></vfx-slider>, with min, max, step and unit. Read el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://vfx-ui-anime.vercel.app

items.name: radio
items.title: VFX UI Anime Radio
items.description: A radio group whose picked dot springs in with a fan of wedges, two puffs and a hollow ポン. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-radio>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: VFX UI Anime Radio is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /vfx-ui-anime/radio.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <vfx-radio label="Plan"><option value="a" selected>Option A</option><option value="b">Option B</option></vfx-radio>. Read el.value and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://vfx-ui-anime.vercel.app

items.name: input
items.title: VFX UI Anime Input

Load /vfx-ui-anime/input.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <vfx-input label="Name" placeholder="Type something"></vfx-input>. Read and set el.value; it fires input and change. items.name: tabs
items.title: VFX UI Anime Tabs
items.description: Tabs where the raised tab slides to the one you pick, stretching, and lands with wedges and a puff. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-tabs>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: VFX UI Anime Tabs is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /vfx-ui-anime/tabs.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <vfx-tabs label="Sections"><option>Home</option><option>Profile</option></vfx-tabs>. Listen for change (e.detail: index, value, label) and show the panel yourself. More: https://vfx-ui-anime.vercel.app

items.name: progress
items.title: VFX UI Anime Progress
items.description: A loading bar with a storm cloud riding its leading edge, pebbles lifting off the ground and ゴゴゴゴ; at the end a burst, ドン! and a check. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-progress>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: VFX UI Anime Progress is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /vfx-ui-anime/progress.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <vfx-progress label="Loading"></vfx-progress>, then el.set(n) with progress from 0 to 1. Listen for sakuga:done (fires once). el.reset() for the next task. More: https://vfx-ui-anime.vercel.app

Read el.value (0 to 5) and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://vfx-ui-anime.vercel.app

items.name: toast
items.title: VFX UI Anime Toast
items.description: A notification that streaks in as a smear, lands in dust with ズザッ, wobbles and leaves by shrinking. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-toast>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: VFX UI Anime Toast is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /vfx-ui-anime/toast.js with a script tag (not a module), then use Put <vfx-toast></vfx-toast> where toasts should appear and call el.show("Saved"). It stays for the duration attribute (2.6 s) or until el.hide(). More: https://vfx-ui-anime.vercel.app
